description:
## Current delivery contract — user-approved two-outcome stack
Owner: PR A. One PR per complete outcome, NOT one PR per bead. Keep detailed beads and cohesive internal commits for tracking; consolidate existing draft foundations into their owning feature PR where practical. PR B stacks on independently usable PR A. Include owning PR documentation and validation there. This supersedes earlier per-bead/prerequisite PR instructions and historical comments. Closed foundation status is not outcome acceptance.
New-feature E2E requires explicit human UX approval in zaq-emb.12; no self-approval.

Channels-owned normalization slice stacked on .14.1. Extend existing communication bridge/provider adapters and normalized Incoming facts for trusted connector/channel/thread identity and per-message recipient evidence. For email: sender copy, visible To/Cc, hidden Bcc only via independently identified receiving account or confirmed outbound envelope, not IMAP folder/Delivered-To/thread-participant guesses; no retroactive association. Reject ambiguous/mismatched accounts and unsupported mapping; preserve current mention gating and legacy ingress. Tests FIRST at adapters/bridge with actual parser fixtures and property tests for recipient deduplication and fail-closed evidence. Reuse existing Channels connector resolution/normalizers, not parallel Action/tool; NodeRouter for cross-service calls. Read Engine/Channels and system-config if touching secrets, docs/action-reuse.md/testing-approach.md; update Channels guide. No new-feature E2E before human UX approval.

comments.text: 2026-09-26 children .14.2.1 shipped as draft PR #813 on #812; .14.2.2 email evidence and .14.2.3 Jido Chat room-type evidence remain open. Email discovery before implementation: ImapAdapter.Parser currently extracts only first To and reply_from (possibly Delivered-To); IMAP mailbox field is folder, not receiving address. EmailBridge.send_reply uses SmtpSender.send_notification(identifier,payload,..) which returns only :ok/error and derives actual sender via payload/settings. Do not infer sender or Bcc from reply thread, Delivered-To, IMAP folder, or configured notification default. To fulfill sender copy and confirmed outbound-envelope Bcc, a receipt must carry the actual sender/envelope recipient without duplicating SmtpSender delivery; preserve legacy return compatibility or extend receipt at owning boundary. Channels normalizes address evidence, Engine .4 resolves Person identities/authorizes targets; no raw Bcc in shared projection. #807/#808/#811 CI green, #812/#813 pending E2E; no new-feature E2E authored.

2026-09-26 issue split updated by deploy risk: .14.2.2 inbound sender/To/Cc normalization (no hidden Bcc without independent evidence), .14.2.4 outbound SmtpSender confirmed sender/envelope receipt, .14.2.3 JidoChat provider-specific room-type enrichment, .14.2.5 independently established IMAP receiving-account identity for hidden Bcc. .14.2.2 blocks .14.2.4 and .14.2.5; .14.2.3 independent after .14.2.1. Do not close parent or claim full email Bcc support while .14.2.5 open; no retroactive audience and no new E2E before UX gate.

title: [zaq-emb.14.2] Normalize trusted provider history facts
